request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere, and no number anywhere except the one large numeral described: no other signs, buttons, plaques, door numbers or license plates show any digit.

Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.

The person's face is fully visible in three-quarter view, looking at what they are doing, not at the camera.

It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.

Keep the person and the thing that carries the meaning inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.

Image 1 shows Ana. Keep her face, long dark wavy hair, light-olive skin and build exactly. Create a new photograph of her: she comes home: she steps out of the open elevator of her apartment building into the small, bright elevator lobby, holding a paper shopping bag, in her sage-green overshirt over a white top and jeans. On the plain light wall beside the elevator door there is one very large dark numeral 6, painted on the wall, about as tall as her head, sharp and easy to read on a phone. The numeral 6 and her face are both inside the central 55 percent of the photo width.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-11-16; before tax, not an invoice.
